[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Markos Tor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Injured in combat, he was sent to recuperate on [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]] with his wife and child. During his convalescence, the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Battle of Stronghold|attacked]] the planet, and Tor led the Alliance defenders.
